notes: Modified cash basis school district. Totals used: Statement of Fund Balances and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p3) Total Governmental Funds column (includes School Nutrition and Activities funds, all governmental). Beginning 1,221,858.22 is the printed beginning fund balance (cash basis); ending 1,836,623.73. Transfers in 170,216.48 (Activities 40,317.95 + Nutrition 129,898.53) and out 170,216.48 net to zero in the total column (Reclassification column eliminates them). The statement's 'Local receipts' (2,589,844.55) was split using the General Fund and Special Building budget schedules; interest on taxes (5,130.67) is inside the statement's Interest line and was split out as property tax; non-revenue receipts split into sale of property 16.00 and other 200.00. Federal and state programs spending is counted under Instruction. Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position (p1), no liabilities. Detail: General Fund receipts from the budget-to-actual schedule (p5); General Fund spending from the Schedule of Cash Disbursements of Operational Expenses by program and object (pp12-17), which supersedes the function-only General Fund statement (p6) so p6 is not recorded; lines printed with a dash are not recorded. The Activities fund is recorded account by account from the detailed schedule (p18), not from the one-line fund schedule (p9): receipts and disbursements per account, General Fund support per account as other financing; Letterman's club disbursements are printed negative (365.00). The 2024 comparative activities schedule (p19) and the all-funds budget comparison (p4) are not recorded. Read pages 1-19 of 19 County receipts 11,110.86 (p3) is entirely GF 2110 Fines and licenses (p5), so it is fines and forfeitures.
